title: Christ never said you can live how you want. | #iuic #israelunitedinchrist #nathanyel7
cleanTitle: Christ never said you can live how you want. |
segments: Read.
They changed our history. You got that?
Yes, sir.
Read.
The book of Psalms, chapter 111 AND
VERSE 10.
THE FEAR OF THE LORD IS THE BEGINNING of
wisdom.
The fear of God, that's the first step
of being wise, to understanding that God
made you. He created you. Therefore, you
need to do what? What he says to do. If
your LIFE IS ANYTHING OTHER, if you're
doing anything other what God told you,
you're on the wrong path. Read.
A good understanding have all they that
do his commandments.
Now, watch this. Notice the Bible says a
good understanding have all they that do
his commandments. Why is it that the
world has told you that Jesus Christ
came and said, "You know what? We ain't
got to do those commandments no more.
You just live your life and hey, it's no
big deal."
JESUS CHRIST NEVER SAID THAT.
RIGHT.
